newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ELBER TO QUIT VFB STUTTGART IN 1997 OR 1998.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ELBER TO QUIT VFB STUTTGART IN 1997 OR 1998.

text.p: Brazilian striker Giovane Elber, one of the hottest properties in German soccer, said on Friday he wanted to quit VfB Stuttgart in June but would wait until after the 1997-98 season if the club forced him to honour his contract.

Elber, 24, who has scored 10 league goals this season as part of the Bundesliga's most potent attack, told the Stuttgarter Zeitung daily that he was disappointed with the club's failure to make him an offer to keep him beyond 1998.
Club president Gerhard Mayer-Vorfelder insists he has made an offer and will not let Elber leave before his contract expires.
Elber said a number of European clubs had shown interest in him, and he hoped to have made a decision by the end of January. Bayern Munich are rumoured to be among the interested parties.
